title: 第21章 两个选择
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
偌大的训练场上，尘土飞扬，一道纤细的身影正在与一名中年男子对战。

    艾丽西亚穿着一身便于活动的劲装，金色的长发束成马尾，随着动作在空中甩动。

    她操控着云雀，翅膀扇动间，一道道锋利的风刃朝着对面飞去。

    对面的中年男子是一名五星御卡师，召唤出的卡兽是一只壮硕的黑熊，可即便如此，在云雀的攻势下，依旧节节败退，黑熊身上已经添了好几道伤口，发出阵阵低吼。

    林奇站在训练场边缘，不由得感慨。

    “本以为城主闺女是喜欢粉刷卡兽的花瓶官二代，没想到战力这么强。”

    他仔细感知着双方的源力波动，艾丽西亚竟然已经是四星御卡师了，和他老爹一个境界！

    可她看起来比自己大不了几岁，顶多十七八岁，比林峰年轻了足足二十岁，这份天赋，实在惊人。

    艾丽西亚似乎察觉到了林奇的目光，她没有停下动作，反而从怀中掏出一张卡牌，指尖源力涌动，卡牌瞬间化作一道绿光，融入云雀体内。

    林奇眯起眼注视，那是一张三星技能卡，虽然星级不低，但品质只是绿色，不过对云雀来说，恰好能最大化发挥效果。

    在源卡大陆，星级高的卡牌，品质不一定高。但品质高的卡牌，星级一定低不了。

    就像是一个制卡学徒，一辈子也只能制作出一星白卡。但突然有一天他灵机一动，或者运气来了，用制作一星卡的材料制作出了一张二星白卡，这都是很常见的事情。

    虽说卡牌的威力提升了，但顶多就比一星卡提升百分之五十的威力。相当于绿色一星卡牌的品质，不可能比绿色二星卡强。

    只见云雀翅膀猛地一振，周身卷起阵阵旋风，如同无形的墙壁，将黑熊的退路全部堵死。

    紧接着，云雀俯冲而下，锋利的鸟喙朝着黑熊的眼睛啄去，中年男子脸色一变，连忙喊道：“小姐，我输了。”

    见对方认输了，艾丽西亚嘴角勾起一抹弧度。

    “那今天的训练就到此为止吧。”

    “回来吧小云雀。”

    云雀化作光芒回到了卡牌之中。

    她转身看向林奇，金色的发丝贴在脸颊上，额角沁着薄汗。
content_en:
On the huge training ground, dust was flying, and a slender figure was fighting with a middle-aged man.

    Alicia wore an outfit that was easy to move around, and her long blond hair was tied into a ponytail, swinging in the air as she moved.

    She controlled Skylark, and when she flapped her wings, sharp wind blades flew towards the opposite side.

    The middle-aged man opposite was a five-star card master, and the card beast he summoned was a strong black bear. But even so, under the attack of Skylark, he was still retreating. The black bear had several wounds on its body and roared.

    Lynch stood on the edge of the training ground and couldn't help but sigh.

    "I thought the city lord's daughter was a second-generation flower vase official who liked to paint card beasts, but I didn't expect her combat power to be so strong."

    He carefully sensed the fluctuations in the source power of both sides, and Alicia was already a four-star card master, the same level as his father!

    But she looks to be a few years older than him, at most seventeen or eighteen years old, a full twenty years younger than Lin Feng. This talent is truly astonishing.

    Alicia seemed to be aware of Lynch's gaze. She did not stop, but took out a card from her arms. Power surged from her fingertips, and the card instantly turned into a green light and merged into Skylark's body.

    Lin Qi squinted his eyes and saw that it was a three-star skill card. Although the star rating was not low, the quality was only green, but for Skylark, it happened to be able to maximize its effect.

    In the Source Card Continent, cards with high stars are not necessarily of high quality. But for high-quality cards, the star rating must not be low.

    It's like a card-making apprentice who can only make one-star white cards in his lifetime. But suddenly one day he had an idea or luck came and used the materials used to make a one-star card to make a two-star white card. This was a very common thing.

    Although the power of the card has been increased, it is only 50% more powerful than a one-star card at most. The quality is equivalent to a green one-star card, but cannot be better than a green two-star card.

    I saw the skylark's wings suddenly fluttering, and whirlwinds rolled up around it, like an invisible wall, blocking all the black bear's retreat.

    Immediately afterwards, the skylark swooped down and pecked the black bear's eyes with its sharp beak. The middle-aged man's expression changed and he shouted quickly: "Miss, I lost."

    Seeing that the other party had admitted defeat, Alicia's lips curved.

    "Then that's the end of today's training."

    "Come back, little Skylark."

    Skylark turned into light and returned to the card.

    She turned to look at Lin Qi, her golden hair sticking to her cheeks, and a thin layer of sweat on her forehead.
